note: The build half: a zero-parameter export records an empty list, which is what selects the fallback at run time.

cases.title: a zero-parameter export reached by an override
cases.rest_in: C3a passes it the non-underscore values

given.source:
export function other() { return [...arguments]; }
export function main() { return 0; }

cases.title: the same zero-parameter function as main
cases.rest_in: C3a calls it with no arguments
